reason: My Saturday walk is when I spend on something special, and a hot chocolate with torched meringue or a half-sweet halva latte is something I'd try and photograph. It's right at the subway exit I come out of, so it's an easy first stop, but I'd treat it as an occasional weekend thing, not every week.
objection: Dessert lattes usually taste like syrup in a cup. Even half-sweet, I worry I'll pay $7.50 for something cloying that looks better than it tastes.
would_change_my_mind: If the first one is genuinely sickly even half-sweet, I wouldn't come back; if it's balanced, I'd make it a regular weekend stop.
